title: Digit Harmony
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: N (up to 1e18, given as a string). Line 2: k.
Print how many x in [1, N] have digitSum(x) divisible by k.

**Constraints:** 1 <= N <= 1e18; 2 <= k <= 100.

**R versus W.** The graded wrong solution enumerates every number.

tests.name: small bound
tests.hint: Digit sums divisible by 3 up to 20: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 — plus 20? 2+0=2 no. Brute-verified.

tests.name: load: N = 1e18, k = 7
tests.hint: Digit DP walks 19 positions x k states; enumeration never terminates.
